sources.name: National Risk Register 2026
sources.usage_limit: A national planning tool, not a prediction and not a parcel-level hazard probability.

sources.usage_limit: Implementation progress and policy commitments are not observed local response performance.

sources.geography: United Kingdom; national and local responder doctrine

sources.name: GOV.UK Emergency Alerts service
sources.geography: Current mobile-network location in the United Kingdom

sources.name: How emergency alerts work
sources.usage_limit: Delivery depends on compatible devices and network conditions; receipt does not quantify hazard likelihood at a parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Fire and rescue national resilience programme
sources.geography: United Kingdom; fire and rescue specialist capabilities
sources.usage_limit: A capability framework, not observed local availability or response time for a parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: National co-ordination and advisory framework for England, 7th edition
sources.geography: England; fire and rescue mutual aid and major-incident coordination
sources.usage_limit: Response doctrine does not prove that a specific resource is available at a particular parcel or time.

sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.name: Environmental Indicator Framework Theme F: Resilience
sources.usage_limit: Indicator trends and readiness states require their native geography and cannot be copied to parcels.

sources.name: Water situation: national monthly reports for England 2026
sources.geography: England; national rainfall, soil moisture, river flow, groundwater and reservoir summaries
sources.usage_limit: National monthly conditions are not parcel observations and cannot replace a catchment or local-area join.

sources.name: Water situation: area monthly reports for England
sources.published_or_current: Updated 17 July 2026 with June 2026 area reports
sources.geography: Environment Agency operational areas in England
sources.usage_limit: Area reports remain broad-area evidence; exact catchment and period compatibility are required before local use.

sources.name: Dry weather and drought in England: 10 July to 16 July 2026
sources.geography: England; Environment Agency areas and named catchments
sources.usage_limit: Status is dynamic and catchment-specific; a current exact catchment join is mandatory before local interpretation.

sources.geography: United Kingdom; weather-driven wildfire severity conditions
sources.usage_limit: The index does not predict when or where a wildfire will start and cannot be treated as parcel ignition probability.
